The damage dealt by the blades after they land on the ground is additionally tagged as [[File:Irelia Vanguard's Edge.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Indirect damage]] [[:Damage|indirect]]. * Enemies that cross the perimeter are '''not''' marked ''Unsteady''. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. * ''Vanguard's Edge'' maintains its casting angle direction in relation to '''Irelia''' if she moves during the cast time. * In addition to its [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|projectile]], ''Vanguard's Edge'' will check for enemy champions within a [[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 90-unit radius area from the projectile's origin point. ** The projectile interacts with projectile-blocking effects but the area check doesn't. * The blades will still expand if the champion hit by the blades is protected by a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. * The [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] is granted in a 1350 unit radius at the location of the enemy champion at the time of being hit and can be blocked by terrain. * If this spell is cast while there are blades from a previous ''Vanguard's Edge'' still active, the previous blades will disappear.@@
